critic: 64 multi-output decision trees; depth 4, leaf minimum 6; bootstrap entire seeds
target: candidate minus native utility, where utility = win + 0.5*tie + 0.05*tanh(margin/3000)
selection_rule: Prefer policies with no negative net win change in any selection opponent; maximize paired win gain, then bounded utility; tie-break toward fewer interventions
promotion_gate: Positive paired win gain, no net win regression in any holdout opponent, no errors/fallbacks, decision latency below 1 second. Requires official confirmation before release.
constant_ablation: Best constant option selected on selection data, compared with the learned critic on holdout
information_boundary: Input features whitelist only observable current own/public state and past public inventory; no seed, opponent identity, future observations or opponent private fields
causal_check: Every option in one context must have identical pre-intervention action hash and identical decision features; all continuations rerun complete adaptive policies with fresh memory
scope: A trained high-level option critic inspired by forum 738079 and Q2RL; not a reproduction of Q2RL or full RL
